body.x: Imagination Garden will participate in theworld’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan.7-10 to showcase its hydroponic cultivator and culture compensator.

The official said, “The market forhydroponic systems is expanding globally because of limited arable land,climate change, and diversification of agricultural consumption. However,systems up to now were very expensive and have extremely limited cultivation.So, we decided that we couldn't keep up with the demands of the market, so welaunched a low-cost plant factory and launched a smart culture compensator tosolve the limited cultivation.”

Major features of the products are asfollows. △ Easy to install and versatile, can be used in idle buildings andplastic houses △ Unlike other companies' systems, it is very inexpensive andgrows high value-added crops by using AI-controlled automatic environmentalmanagement system △ System for researching and recalibrating optimalculture recipes by measuring the rate of change of individual ions absorbed bycrops and growing seasons △ Possible to produce crops that have not beenhydroponic because recipes are not known △ Functional vegetables can be grown,by either strengthening or weakening specific characteristics of the crops

The official said, “The main targets arethe US, Singapore and East Asia, and we are also interested in Southeast Asianmarket that is also interested in agriculture. We are conducting research onmedicinal crops, and planning to maximize added value. We are planning toincrease the number of partners and affiliated farmers by participating invarious domestic and international exhibitions in 2020."

The world’s largest IT show CES shows thetrend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted byConsumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS hasreported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major techexhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES thisyear to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstandingKorean companies to the world.
